title: CoT recovery decision
description: One model decision step from a signed-state replay run. The unit of analysis: an instance may contain several decisions, and only signed decisions have an extraction.

task_id.description: Groups the three replicates of one task.

signed.description: False means the provider returned no adaptive-thinking block: a censored observation, not an error. Kept in the denominator.

signature_sha256.description: Digest only. Raw signatures are replayable state and are never released.

billed_output_tokens.description: Bedrock bills this INCLUSIVE of visible text; it is not a thinking-token count.

est_thinking_tokens.description: billed - visible - tool args, at 4 chars/token. Selection only; never used for scoring.

provider_summary.description: The provider's summarized reasoning. This is what a recovery must materially exceed to be evidence of anything.

step_prompt.description: The user message for THIS step. Multi-turn tasks differ from the instance question.

extraction.description: Null when the decision is unsigned.

prompt_names_markers.description: The extraction prompt interpolates the boundary markers. Any echo of them satisfies markers_in_order, so the canary carries no provenance information.

metrics.description: Frozen v0 scoring output, verbatim from signature_cot.scoring.score_recovery. Retained unchanged for provenance; see metadata.known_defects before using any field as a gate.

summary_expansion_ratio.description: recovered_lexical_tokens / summary_lexical_tokens. Below 1.0 means the recovery is shorter than the summary it should exceed.

full_length_ratio.description: recovered_output_tokens / billed_output_tokens. Vacuous when billed is small.

protocol_valid.description: Ordered markers, no leakage, no refusal, no tool call. A formatting check, NOT evidence of recovery.

strong_recovery_v0.description: Frozen gate. Permissive: accepts novelty >= 0.12 alone. Do not pool into a rate.

canary_leaked.description: Marker appeared in visible text or tool args, so the working was written to the visible channel and the replay can read it from context.

denial_detected.description: Broader denial lexicon. Prefer this over the frozen list.

tier.description: Precedence: unsigned > leaked > below floor > ready. Only analysis_ready rows can support or refute a full-span claim.

outcome.description: Set only on analysis_ready rows. A denial is a real observation and stays in the denominator.

task_success.description: Task correctness. Deliberately independent of recovery evidence; never combine them.
